# infoblox_tsig_key (Resource)

Manages an Infoblox TsigKey in the UDDI backend.

## Example Usage

### UDDI Backend

```terraform
// Create a TSIG Key with Basic Fields
resource "infoblox_tsig_key" "tsig_key_with_basic_fields" {
  uddi = {
    name   = "tsig-key-basic.example.com."
    secret = "wuQuR0A08ApqKT65yaGiqWHalHxS7Ie8LF2VTUFZFZo="
  }
}

// Create a TSIG Key with Additional Fields
resource "infoblox_tsig_key" "tsig_key_with_additional_fields" {
  uddi = {
    name   = "tsig-key-additional.example.com."
    secret = "FzpyuZuQAHxLmwZVGlYcwaPB7Ow9MSWqSyyJlNR1XUc="

    // Additional Fields
    algorithm = "hmac_sha512"
    comment   = "TSIG Key created by Terraform"
    tags = {
      Site = "location-1"
    }
  }
}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `uddi` (Attributes) UDDI backend-specific fields. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--uddi))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The resource identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--uddi"></a>
### Nested Schema for `uddi`

Required:

- `name` (String) The TSIG key name in the absolute domain name format.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) The TSIG key secret as a Base64 encoded string.

Optional:

- `algorithm` (String) The TSIG key algorithm.  Valid values are: * _hmac_sha1_ * _hmac_sha224_ * _hmac_sha256_ * _hmac_sha384_ * _hmac_sha512_  Defaults to _hmac_sha256_.
- `comment` (String) The description for the TSIG key. May contain 0 to 1024 characters. Can include UTF-8.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the TSIG key in JSON format.

Read-Only:

- `tags_all` (Map of String) All tags including inherited values.
